title: He was born in Bihar, moved to Delhi at 12, then Wales as a teenager. In 2026, he became Britain's first AI minister.

sources.text: Business Today - All about Kanishka Narayan, the Indian-origin MP named UK's first AI Minister

caption:
He was born in Bihar, moved to Delhi at 12, then Wales as a teenager. In 2026, he became Britain's first AI minister.

Under new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, the newly created role spans both the Cabinet Office and the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade - a sign of how central AI policy has become to UK governance.

Educated at Oxford and Stanford, with a career spanning Silicon Valley, the UK civil service and finance, he was promoted into the AI minister role after first serving as Parliamentary Under-Secretary for AI and Online Safety.

Narayan's path - Muzaffarpur to Delhi to Cardiff to Whitehall - is a reminder that India's talent pipeline now reaches directly into the rooms where the next technology's rules get written.
